mentions.name: CVD Portal
mentions.description: CVD Portal is a free whitelabel Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure platform for EU manufacturers, with tooling for the incoming Cyber Resilience Act, which from September 2026 requires a 24-hour early-warning and 72-hour report to ENISA for actively exploited vulnerabilities. It offers free no-signup self-assessment and exposure-scan tools as a top-of-funnel to reach manufacturers unaware of their obligations.
mentions.problem: From September 2026 the Cyber Resilience Act obliges manufacturers to file a 24-hour early-warning and 72-hour report to ENISA for actively exploited vulnerabilities, and many don't yet know they have this obligation.
mentions.audience: EU manufacturers subject to the incoming Cyber Resilience Act, including those who don't yet know they have an obligation
mentions.source_excerpt: Building CVD Portal, a free whitelabel Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure platform for EU manufacturers, plus tooling for the incoming Cyber Resilience Act.
